items.question: Which WNBA team did Deanna Nolan play for?
items.answer: Deanna Nolan played her whole WNBA career with the Detroit Shock, who drafted her sixth overall in 2001 out of Georgia. In nine seasons (2001 to 2009) she won three WNBA titles, in 2003, 2006 and 2008, and was the 2006 WNBA Finals MVP. In 2016 she was named to the WNBA Top 20@20 team.

items.question: What did Deanna Nolan average in the WNBA?
items.answer: Deanna Nolan averaged 13.6 points, 3.8 rebounds and 3.2 assists in 293 WNBA regular-season games, all for Detroit. In 48 playoff games she averaged 18.1 points.

items.question: Is Deanna Nolan in a hall of fame?
items.answer: Deanna Nolan was inducted into the Michigan Sports Hall of Fame in 2024. She grew up in Flint, where she led Flint Northern to back-to-back state titles and was named Michigan's Miss Basketball.
